# Anivora 0.1.31 — Horizontal avatar rows and Google profile photos

- Restore one horizontally scrolling portrait row per anime, matching the Th3-Anime reference. Restore the reference group order, with vertical scrolling between groups. Both lists remain virtualized, and portraits still load on demand from the public assets repository.
- Restore existing Google account photos instead of incorrectly displaying the default Naruto portrait. The original Google photo URL is preserved when signing in, opening/closing the picker, or saving a name. Only explicitly selecting an illustrated avatar saves its stable avatar ID.
- Preserve trusted AniList profile photos as well. Account-provider photo hosts have a narrow HTTPS allowlist separate from the stricter public avatar catalog allowlist.
- Keep the remote catalog, twelve-hour cache, Retry, six bundled offline defaults and every saved avatar migration. GitHub Releases updates, Cloudflare pages, on-device manga and server-status notices remain unchanged. No avatar or APK bytes are hosted on Render.

Android version code: **33**. Package: `com.brandon300.anivora`. ARM64, Android 7.0/API 24 or newer. Existing signing certificate retained for installation over the previous version; install over the existing app to retain local data.

Validation: TypeScript, lint, Expo compatibility and Expo Doctor, app/backend tests, browser scenarios at 393/360/320 px covering horizontal scrolling and Google photo preservation with online/offline catalogs, native tests and Android emulator integration. Release verification checks APK signature/package/version/architecture, compiled source and exactly six bundled portrait hashes. Public download and checksum verification precede update-feed publication.

This corrects photo rendering; it does not overwrite account avatar records. If an illustrated avatar was explicitly selected and saved, that selection remains. Physical Infinix Hot 50i/XOS installation and rendering have not been tested.

Source commit: https://github.com/brandon-300/Anivora/commit/7484824b74065f5eb5b3aa0c59dbc949c5bd3775
